name: SB-Restaurant Steiner
kurzbeschreibung: **SB-Restaurant Steiner in Stans** is a cozy, family-run eatery nestled in the heart of **Stans**, offering hearty Swiss dishes with a touch of Alpine charm. Whether you're craving a classic **Rösti** with melted cheese, a savory **Zürcher Geschnetzeltes**, or a sweet **Bündnerflecken** for dessert, this place delivers authentic flavors in a warm, rustic setting. The friendly service and generous portions make it a beloved spot for both locals and visitors exploring the scenic beauty of **Nidwalden**. Don’t miss their homemade **Brot**—perfect for soaking up every last drop of your soup!
